go-jsonschema validate --schema schema.json --output verbose any.json
# Without --format-assert, /format is annotation-only per spec §F.2:
# a "bad" uuid is still valid and the format name surfaces as the
# annotation value.
stdout '"keywordLocation":"/format"'
stdout '"annotation":"uuid"'

-- schema.json --
{"format": "uuid"}
-- any.json --
"not-a-uuid"
